'''Dutonian''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] working on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] hired him and his men to lay an ambush for the [[Voidhound]] in the [[Hangar RS-32]] of [[Pallista Spaceport]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The mercenary's confidence in the numbers against the smuggler led to his death in the firefight.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Captain, say hello to Sergeant Dutonian and his men. They were working freelance for the houses, but now they work for me|Skavak to the smuggler|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Dutonian led a [[Dutonian's mercenaries|group]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that did freelance work for the various [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Houses]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. In<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="DatingLogic" /> Dutonian accepted a contract from the notorious criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] to ambush a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] in [[Hangar RS-32]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
